title: Approved - Keys in My Hand

Preserve its original key, tempo, melody contours, chord progression, soulful male R&B vocal timbre, close group harmonies, phrasing, groove, drums, bass, keyboards, arrangement and mix character as closely as possible. Use ONLY the supplied new car-approval lyrics, never original words. Begin the opening approval hook immediately. Keep the natural lead and layered harmonies and source vocal processing; do not add a new genre. Match the source's overall length and emotional arc. Include a clearly exposed melodic ELECTRIC GUITAR SOLO with no lead singing, then later a separate clearly exposed BASS GUITAR SOLO with no lead singing, as marked in the lyrics. Return smoothly to the hook after each solo. Warm, hopeful and confident; low down payment, credit challenges, written terms and dealer peace of mind. Finish with the final approval hook and a clean ending. One version.
